beats.label: S1 · A fresh start built on a murder
beats.text: Georgia moves her kids to Wellsbury after Kenny's death, which flashbacks reveal she caused by poisoning his smoothie with wolfsbane.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the founding lie the whole series turns on: Georgia is a killer who has run somewhere respectable.

beats.label: S1 · Broke and skimming
beats.text: She takes a job with Mayor Paul, opens credit cards in Austin's name, and skims town funds while Kenny's ex-wife blocks his contested inheritance.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The embezzlement and identity fraud are the ordinary crimes that will finally give her enemies traction.

beats.label: S1 · Ginny finds her people, and Marcus
beats.text: Ginny joins the MANG friend group and dates Hunter, but secretly loses her virginity to Max's twin Marcus and hides that she burns herself with a lighter.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the two threads that dominate S2: the self-harm Marcus alone knows about, and the betrayal that will break the friend group.

beats.label: S1 · A PI with a hunch
beats.text: Kenny's ex-wife hires PI Gabriel Cordova, who romances Georgia's sister Maddie for intel and pieces together that wolfsbane killed Kenny.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the outsider who will chase Georgia through both remaining seasons.

beats.label: S1 · A proposal, an affair, a friendship in flames
beats.text: Paul proposes just as Georgia sleeps with Zion again; she says yes. Marcus tells Ginny he loves her, they have sex, and Max finds his phone.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks Georgia into the mayor's fiancée role and detonates the friend group Ginny built the season around.

beats.label: S1 · Fireworks and a missing body
beats.text: Cynthia finds proof Georgia embezzled, Gabriel exhumes Kenny to find the body gone, and Georgia calmly burns him into Paul's election fireworks.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Every enemy she'll face in S2 now has ammunition, and the show has confirmed for the audience exactly what she's capable of.

beats.label: S1 · Ginny runs
beats.text: Warned by Gabriel that her mother may be dangerous, Ginny finds Georgia's gun and Austin's forged letters, and takes Austin away on Marcus's motorcycle.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season ends with Georgia's greatest achievement — the family — already walking out the door.

cliffhanger.text: Paul has just won re-election, unaware his new fiancée has embezzled from him, burned her dead husband into his fireworks, and had her children flee on the back of a motorcycle. Cynthia has proof of the money, Gabriel has proof of the murder, and Ginny is somewhere on the road with Austin.
questions: Where does Ginny take Austin, and does she come back?
What does Gabriel do now that he knows Georgia poisoned Kenny?
Can Georgia's engagement survive Cynthia's evidence surfacing?

characters.name: Georgia Miller
characters.line: Charming single mother and mayoral aide, con artist with a violent past, quietly a serial killer and now engaged to Paul.

characters.name: Ginny Miller
characters.line: Georgia's biracial 15-year-old daughter, self-harming in secret, who has just discovered her mother's gun and fled with her brother.

characters.name: Austin Miller
characters.line: Georgia's 9-year-old son; his father Gil is in prison and every letter from him was written by Georgia.

characters.name: Paul Randolph
characters.line: Wellsbury's newly re-elected mayor, engaged to Georgia and still believing he understands who she is.

characters.name: Zion Miller
characters.line: Ginny's biological father, an itinerant photographer who slept with Georgia again this season before backing away for her sake.

characters.name: Marcus Baker
characters.line: Max's depressive twin brother, secretly in love with Ginny; their affair has just imploded the friend group.

characters.name: Max Baker
characters.line: Ginny's best friend, who has just learned that both her brother and Ginny lied to her all year.

characters.name: Cynthia Fuller
characters.line: Paul's mayoral rival with a comatose husband, holding fresh proof that Georgia embezzled from the town.
characters.note: Introduced late; will drive S2's murder plot.

characters.name: Gabriel Cordova
characters.line: The PI hired to investigate Georgia, now certain she poisoned Kenny and has warned Ginny she may be dangerous.

characters.name: Joe
characters.line: Owner of Blue Farm café; has been quietly in love with Georgia since a chance meeting when they were teenagers, which she does not remember.

beats.label: S2 · Ginny comes back to keep a secret
beats.text: Ginny and Austin have been with Zion for two weeks; she agrees to therapy but moves back home only to stop Zion telling Georgia about her self-harm.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's terms: Ginny is home, in therapy, and holding the leverage of her own harm against her mother.

beats.label: S2 · Ginny tells Marcus what Georgia did
beats.text: Ginny confides in Marcus that Georgia killed Kenny; he keeps the secret. Georgia moves Paul in and reconciles with Ginny after an angry showdown.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Marcus becomes the second person alive who knows, quietly binding him and Ginny for the rest of the season.

beats.label: S2 · Gil comes home
beats.text: Austin's father Gil is released from prison and pushes his way back into Austin's life, and flashbacks reveal how badly he once beat Georgia.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The abusive ex-husband is now in the frame, and the audience knows why Georgia is terrified even while she plays it cool.

beats.label: S2 · Marcus and Ginny go public, and Georgia reads the notebook
beats.text: Marcus's depression deepens as he officially dates Ginny; Georgia reads Ginny's notebook and finds both the self-harm and a poem casting her as a monster.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Georgia can no longer pretend she doesn't know; Ginny can no longer pretend Georgia doesn't see her.

beats.label: S2 · Anthony, and Austin pulls a trigger
beats.text: Gabriel tells Ginny about Anthony Green, Georgia's dead first husband; when Gil attacks Georgia soon after, Austin shoots him with a gun he found in the house.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ginny learns her mother has a bigger body count than she knew, and Austin becomes complicit in violence for the first time.

beats.label: S2 · A pillow over Tom's face
beats.text: Georgia suffocates Cynthia's dying husband Tom, unaware Austin is watching. Marcus, ashamed of his depression, breaks up with Ginny.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The murder the trial hangs on, with the only witness being her own son — and Ginny loses the one relationship holding her steady.

beats.label: S2 · Married, then arrested
beats.text: Georgia marries Paul after finally confessing her past to him, but Nick learns the truth from Gabriel and Georgia is arrested for Tom's murder mid-first-dance.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season closes on the exact tableau S3 opens on: a mayor's wife in handcuffs, a bewildered child, and no one sure who tipped the police.

cliffhanger.text: Georgia has been arrested at her own wedding reception for the murder of Tom Fuller. Austin, the only person who actually saw it happen, insists he told no one — meaning somebody else has moved against her, and Paul has been married to her for a matter of hours.
questions: If Austin didn't talk, who did?
Does Paul stand by his wife now that he knows what she is?
Can Georgia beat a murder charge when her ten-year-old is the sole eyewitness?

characters.name: Georgia Miller
characters.line: Newly Mrs. Randolph, arrested for Tom's murder minutes after her first dance.

characters.name: Ginny Miller
characters.line: In therapy for self-harm, recently dumped by Marcus, and now the child of a woman in handcuffs.

characters.name: Austin Miller
characters.line: Shot Gil in self-defence, watched Georgia smother Tom, and is still carrying both secrets.

characters.name: Paul Randolph
characters.line: Mayor of Wellsbury who married Georgia hours before her arrest, having only just learned her real history.

characters.name: Marcus Baker
characters.line: Ended things with Ginny, telling her his depression means he cannot be with anyone; is drinking more and hiding it.

characters.name: Cynthia Fuller
characters.line: Newly widowed, and the woman whose husband Georgia has just been charged with killing.

characters.name: Gabriel Cordova
characters.line: The PI who dated Nick to get closer to Georgia, and who has just handed the police everything he has on her.

characters.name: Zion Miller
characters.line: Ginny's father, back in Boston, still hovering as the safe alternative to Georgia's chaos.

characters.name: Gil Timmins
characters.line: Austin's father — physically abusive to Georgia, freshly shot by his own son, and quietly plotting his next move.

characters.name: Joe
characters.line: Blue Farm's owner; briefly slept with Cynthia, still in love with Georgia, and one of very few people rooting for her.

beats.label: S3 · House arrest and a confession
beats.text: Georgia pleads not guilty and is placed on house arrest; she confesses all three murders to Ginny and admits she has no plan for beating the trial.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ginny now knows the whole ledger, and the season's tension is whether she'll fight for her mother anyway.

beats.label: S3 · Ginny pulls away, and hides
beats.text: Ginny warns Austin to say nothing about what he saw, tells Georgia she needs space, and quietly dates a poetry-class boy under a fake name.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's Ginny arc — hiding from her own life — starts here, and Austin is locked into the lie that will end the season.

beats.label: S3 · Marcus falls apart
beats.text: Spiralling into drinking, Marcus tells Ginny he no longer loves her, vandalises a teacher's classroom, and is suspended as his depression takes over.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The one relationship Ginny relied on collapses just as she needs it most, isolating her for the pregnancy to come.

beats.label: S3 · Gabriel on the stand, CPS at the door
beats.text: Gabriel publicly accuses Georgia of serial murder from the witness box, and Zion and Gil use the fallout to file for custody and bring CPS to the house.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The trial goes national and the kids are actively being pulled away from Georgia by their own fathers.

beats.label: S3 · Pregnancy and abortion
beats.text: Ginny discovers she is pregnant; Georgia and Marcus quietly get her through an abortion, and she breaks up with the father for how little he showed up.
beats.whyLoadBearing: It's the beat that pushes Ginny back to Georgia and produces the pregnancy test Georgia weaponises next.

beats.label: S3 · A fake pregnancy, and Paul is done
beats.text: Paul moves to divorce Georgia, so she lies she is pregnant using Ginny's test; when he learns the truth he tells her the family is better off without her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The marriage that was Georgia's whole plan is quietly finished, even if the paperwork isn't.

beats.label: S3 · Georgia runs, Austin lies
beats.text: Georgia sleeps with Joe and flees on Marcus's bike before turning herself in; on the stand Austin shocks the courtroom by naming Gil as Tom's killer.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season ends with Georgia's fate hanging on a lie told by a ten-year-old — the fulcrum the next season opens on.

cliffhanger.text: The trial is nearing its verdict with Austin's perjury as the most dramatic testimony the jury has heard — Georgia's freedom now depends on a lie her ten-year-old son has just told under oath, framing his own abusive father.
questions: Will the jury believe Austin's story that Gil killed Tom?
Can Ginny live with letting her brother perjure himself to save Georgia?
Where does Georgia's marriage to Paul stand after everything he has said?

characters.name: Georgia Miller
characters.line: On trial for Tom's murder, back in custody after a brief attempt to run, defended by her ex's new girlfriend.

characters.name: Ginny Miller
characters.line: Coordinated Georgia's defence with Simone, had an abortion mid-season, and is now single and back at her mother's side.

characters.name: Austin Miller
characters.line: Just committed perjury on the witness stand to save Georgia by pinning Tom's murder on Gil.

characters.name: Paul Randolph
characters.line: Publicly still Georgia's husband, privately finished with her after her fake-pregnancy lie.

characters.name: Marcus Baker
characters.line: Broken up with Ginny, drinking heavily, and now with his family aware of the depression he tried to hide.

characters.name: Zion Miller
characters.line: Ginny's father; called CPS on Georgia, took Ginny to her abortion, and is dating Simone.

characters.name: Gil Timmins
characters.line: Austin's father — abusive, still trying to seize custody, and now falsely accused of murder in open court.

characters.name: Joe
characters.line: Blue Farm's owner; slept with Georgia once, still visits her in prison, still in love with her.

characters.name: Gabriel Cordova
characters.line: The PI whose stand testimony finally made Georgia's alleged body count public knowledge.

characters.name: Simone
characters.line: Zion's girlfriend and a lawyer, now leading Georgia's defence at Ginny's request.
characters.note: Newly introduced this season; the trial rides on her.
